test_title: PYST 26: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that correctly expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Mr. Amar refused him admittance.

options.text: Admittance will be refused to him by Mr. Amar.
Admittance shall be refused to him by Mr. Amar.
Admittance would be refused to him by Mr. Amar.
Admittance was refused to him by Mr. Amar.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Mr. Amar refused him admittance."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "admittance" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "refused" to "was refused" (past simple passive).
 
• Add the preposition "to" followed by the indirect object "him" and the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "Mr. Amar."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Admittance was refused to him by Mr. Amar."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Admittance will be refused to him by Mr. Amar." – Incorrect tense (future simple passive).
 
• **Option 2: **"Admittance shall be refused to him by Mr. Amar." – Incorrect use of modal verb "shall."
 
• **Option 3: **"Admittance would be refused to him by Mr. Amar." – Incorrect tense (conditional passive).
